entry.title: LX-800 1.1.0
entry.summary: An 8-voice paraphonic synth in the spirit of early-80s budget polysynths: divide-down staircase oscillators, one shared resonant 24/12 dB filter with its own envelope, six-stage rate envelopes, delayed LFO, stereo chorus and a chord step sequencer synced to the MPC. 63 presets and a programmer-chart screen with live LED readouts. **Features** - 8 voices with one oscillator each, or 4 voices with two (interval 0–12 semitones, detune to −20 cents). - Oscillators built from octave-stacked square wa
